description: Save a trip (hotel, sights, food spots — any places), plus the chosen flights and hotel bookings, to GeoTok and get a public link; the GeoTok app keeps the trip available offline. Opening the link on an iPhone with the GeoTok app puts each place on the user's map, and the app reminds them when they are near one. Each item needs a name; lat/lng, address, kind, note and day are optional, and places without coordinates are looked up by name. Items must not contain personal details.

bookings.description: Flights and hotels the user chose or booked in this chat, so GeoTok keeps them with the trip for offline use. Itinerary facts only — never confirmation codes, ticket numbers or traveller names (the trip link is shareable; the user adds those privately in the app).

name: save_trip_to_geotok
title: Save trip to GeoTok
